services.name: Book a Cruise
services.desc: We’re teaming up with Baltimore Fitness instructor Marissa Walch for Yachty Pilates! Grab your fitness mat and come aboard the Raven for a mat Pilates class on this 90-minute cruise through Baltimore’s Inner Harbor. We'll have a 45-minute all-levels class followed by time to hang out, sip a coffee or mimosa, and take in the sights. Beverages will be available for purchase from our full-service bar. We cruise rain or shine as Raven has a beautiful, covered main deck perfect for mat Pilates if the weather doesn't go our way. (Fitness mats not provided.) blurb: Watermark offers a variety of cruises from 40 minutes to a full day, walking tours with period-attired guides, private yacht charters for events, and educational field trips. They operate in Annapolis and Baltimore, focusing on history, culture, and the Chesapeake Bay area. The company has been family-owned since 1972 and emphasizes knowledgeable guides and well-maintained yachts.

quotes.text: Thank you to Watermark for helping me to throw the best party of the decade!!! ... It was an amazing evening of dancing, great food, and creating memories!!! The staff was very friendly and accommodating…Highly recommended!!!!

The group experience was very great, and our crew was phenomenal. Every part of the process was handled by great staff…My experience was so great. I will be bringing my family back to take a tour. Thank you Watermark!

Every aspect of this trip was excellent. Very easy to plan, great and quick communication, all tour guides were wonderful, all students, chaperones, and teachers had excellent feedback to share... We are so thankful!

Cruise was beyond expectations, so happy we decided on Watermark for this event. Always available to answer questions and satisfy special requests…Everyone had a great time. Thanks for a memorable experience!
